```yaml
descriptor:
  id: noncompliant-device-report
  name: Noncompliant Device Report
  description: Reviews managed devices and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_managed_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Reads managed devices from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - complianceState
        - userPrincipalName
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: summarize_noncompliant
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short managed devices report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review managed devices for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total managed devices: {{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}.
        Details: {{ load_managed_devices.output }}.
        Write a compact report: list how many devices are noncompliant, name the
        most common noncompliant state, and advise what to verify first (e.g., device
        configuration, policy assignment, or user action).
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 250
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: >-
      {{ summarize_noncompliant.output }}
    data:
      total: '{{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}'
      noncompliant: '{{ load_managed_devices.output | selectattr("complianceState", "==",
        "Noncompliant") | list | size }}'
      mostCommonState: '{{ load_managed_devices.output | groupby("complianceState") |
        sort(attribute="1") | last | first }}'
      firstNoncompliant: '{{ load_managed_devices.output | selectattr("complianceState",
        "==", "Noncompliant") | first }}'
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Reviews groups and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load groups
    detail: Reads groups from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_by_group_types
    format: transform
    label: Count groups by type
    detail: Tallies groups according to their groupTypes.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - All
        - Security
        - Microsoft 365
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings
    detail: Generates a short groups report for the admin.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review groups for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total groups: {{ load_groups.output | size }}. Details: {{ count_by_group_types.output }}.
        Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: weekly
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_groups.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_group_types.output }}'
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top noncompliant models
  description: Reviews managed devices and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_managed_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Reads managed devices from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count devices by complianceState
    detail: Tallies managed devices per complianceState.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_managed_devices.output }}'
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown
  - id: oldest_items
    format: transform
    label: Sample devices by lastSyncDateTime
    detail: Lists managed devices ordered by lastSyncDateTime.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: '{{ load_managed_devices.output }}'
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    detail: Generates a short managed devices report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review managed devices for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total managed devices: {{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}.
        Breakdown by complianceState: {{ count_by_compliance.output }}.
        Details: {{ oldest_items.output }}.
        Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_managed_devices.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_compliance.output }}'
      sample: '{{ oldest_items.output }}'
```
